Internal helper: run an analysis function's body, printing or silent

Source: R/pipeline-internals.R
dot-jst_output_scope.Rd

Wraps the whole body of each analysis function (jdesc, jfreq, jmulti, jt, jaov, jcrosstab, jlm, jlogistic, jcorr, jalpha, jscreen). The body's standard output goes to a buffer of the scope's own – and on to the Console as well when the call prints (.jst_print_on()) – and each message it signals is recorded in its place among that output, and muffled when the call does not print (every note goes through message()). Warnings and errors pass: a warning is a condition the handler leaves alone, and an error unwinds through the scope's on.exit, so both show as they always have. The body's own return() calls, on.exit() calls, sys.call() and match.call() work as before: the body is a promise evaluated in the function's own frame. The value is the body's, visible or not as the body left it.

Usage

.jst_output_scope(print, body)

Arguments

print

The call's print argument, already checked.

body

The function's body, braced.

Value

The body's value.

Details

Session 423 (the (S422) printed-result item, ruled S423): what the call printed – or, under print = FALSE or joutput("silent"), would have printed – is kept on its result as the attribute jstats_output (.jst_scope_result()), so a saved result typed at the Console, or given to print(), shows that output again (.jst_print_result()). The color the output takes in the RStudio Console is decided before the scope's buffer is opened – an open sink turns .jst_use_color() off – and held for the body through options(jstats.color =), put back as the scope exits, so the Console shows the colors it always did and the kept text carries them. A body that returns early – jdesc()'s grouped form, jcorr()'s two-variable form – attaches through .jst_scope_result() itself, which reads the innermost scope open; a call given a single vector returns the result of a second call, which kept its own. Before Session 423 a call that did not print wrote its output to a null file.
